_note: Components (<Comp>, <svelte:component>, <svelte:self>) accept only let:, on:, bind:, attachments and spreads; an on: directive may carry only a single `once` modifier. The compiler checks these, together with the slot attribute, for every attribute before it visits any attribute, so they win over a later-raised binding error but follow attribute order among themselves. Verified against svelte-check 4.4.6.
